title: Car Rental Rate Classes: Closing a Rental Off on Return and Settling the Miles
content:
When a renter hands back the vehicle they hired, the rental is closed off and the miles driven beyond what the hire included are settled in the same act. The result this basis governs is the money settled for those miles; the observable effect is that the renter afterwards holds no vehicle on the agreement and sees one excess mileage entry closing it off.

The excess mileage settled at return is worked out only after the included allowance owed for the rental stands granted on it.

**Whose act it is.** Handing the vehicle back and closing the agreement off is the renter's own act on their own rental. The desk works the settlement out from the published terms of the Car Rental Rate Classes and the rental's own records; the return itself is confirmed by the customer themselves.

**How the tool is reached.** The tool `close_rental_return_9b1c513c` belongs to the renter: the desk unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it. One call by the renter moves the rental record to returned, stamps it with the moment it came back, and puts a single excess mileage line at the amount supplied onto the rental's ledger against the card held for the hire.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `drive_rental_id` | The reference number of the renter's own car rental agreement being closed off, as it stands on the rental record returned by the car rental lookup | An identifier |
| `excess_mileage_charge_usd` | The money settled for the miles driven beyond what the hire included | A positive amount in US dollars with 2 decimal places, rounded half to even at the last step only, carrying no currency symbol and no thousands separator |

**Return.** The call comes back with a confirmation sentence naming the rental agreement now standing as returned, the reference of the excess mileage line just settled and the amount in US dollars to two decimal places that now stands on the ledger. Any other text means the return was not recorded.
